user.title: Connect to MyElectrica
user.description: Enter your MyElectrica email and password.

select_nlc.description: You can monitor all consumption locations or only specific ones. Select what you want to track.

error.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check your email and password.
error.no_data: Authentication successful, but no data found for this account.
error.no_nlc_selected: You must select at least one consumption location or enable the option for all.

abort.already_configured: This MyElectrica account is already configured.

settings.title: Account Settings

licenta.title: MyElectrica license
licenta.description:
{license_status}

Enter the license key you received by email.

data_description.license_key: The key from your license email, in the form MELC-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

select_nlc.title: Select consumption locations to monitor
select_nlc.description: Update the consumption locations you want to monitor.

error.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check your email and password.
error.no_data: Authentication successful, but no data found for this account.
error.no_nlc_selected: You must select at least one consumption location or enable the option for all.
error.license_key_invalid: This key is not valid for MyElectrica. Copy the whole key from the email: keys for this integration start with MELC-.
error.license_already_used: This key is active on another Home Assistant instance. The license email address receives a link to move it; after you confirm, enter the key here again.
error.license_fingerprint_mismatch: Activation could not be confirmed for this instance. Try again; if the message repeats, use the “License problem” form.
error.license_network_error: The license server cannot be reached. Check that Home Assistant has internet access and try again.
error.license_server_error: The license server could not check the key right now. Try again in a few minutes.
error.already_configured: This account is already configured in another entry.

trial_expired.title: The MyElectrica free trial has ended
trial_expired.description:
Sensors stop updating until a license is activated.

[Get a license]({learn_more_url})

license_expired.title: The MyElectrica license has expired
license_expired.description:
Sensors stop updating until the license is renewed.

[Get a new license]({learn_more_url})
